decisions: Return binding, explicit ownership shape binding, callback result binding and parallel-role names have one compiled CSharp authority.
SLG reference signature registration consumes the generated policy rather than maintaining separate boolean conditions.
Metadata signature registration visits only abstract shapes belonging to the same keyed definition categories; unrelated concrete trait constraints are not type-universe records.
The existing synthetic identity interner supplies structural identity and generic-role aliases without changing ordinary ABI registration entry points.
scope: Signature-selection foundation only; abstract metadata names, layout rows and actual cache-universe consumption remain pending.
